# Salgsstart Valseverket

I hjertet av Nydalen kommer Valseverket – et nytt boligprosjekt med 152 leiligheter i varige
kvaliteter. Her legges det til rette for et levende bymiljø, med grønne takhager, gode uteområder og
aktive byrom på bakkeplan.

Du bor tett på byliv, kollektivtilbud, butikker og servering, med Akerselva i umiddelbar nærhet.
Leilighetene varierer i størrelse og er tilpasset ulike livsfaser, med fokus på gode planløsninger
og hverdagskvaliteter. Salget av leilighetene er nå i gang.

[Les mer om Valseverket her][18]

[][19]

## [Kystbyen Slemmestad][20]

I Kystbyen Slemmestad vokser det snart frem et levende nabolag og bysentrum. Her blir det 1300
boliger og et rikt kultur- og servicetilbud. Her vil du ha alt du trenger for å bo, leve, dele og
oppleve – med nærhet til sjø, natur, og alt som trengs for å leve et komfortabelt og aktivt liv!
[Les mer om Slemmestad her.][21]

 

## [«*Det beste for byen er også det beste for oss*»][22]

Hvorfor Elkjøp, ice og noen av de største selskapene i Norge er kunder hos Avantor? [Få svaret fra
noen av våre fornøyde kunder her][23].

## Miljøprosjektet Nydalen
## – fra nedlagt industri til yrende liv

Historien om Nydalen er like mangslungen som elven den ligger ved. Den forteller om et område preget
av skog, senere tungindustri, så tomme fabrikkhaller og som nå yrer av liv igjen.

Siden tidlig på 90-tallet har Avantor vært den største bydelsutvikleren i Nydalen. For å skape en
grønn og moderne bydel, satte vi miljøstrategi øverst på agendaen. [Les mer om det vi har gjort for
Nydalen her][24].

# [Vi gjør alt][25]
# [for byens beste][26]

Det betyr også å gjøre det beste for våre kunder og alle deres ansatte. Vi er en av landets mest
erfarne eiendomsforvaltere og håndterer i dag mer enn 330.000 kvadratmeter eiendom. [Les mer om
drift og forvaltning her][27].

## A Trusted Partner of Life Science Research and the Biopharmaceutical Industry


We are living in the bio-century. Global medical knowledge is expanding at a rapid pace. But despite
huge breakthroughs, many diseases, such as cancer, rheumatism or Alzheimer's, are still not
curable.  Sartorius is part of the solution.

We help to ensure that new scientific discoveries can be translated more quickly into effective
patient care. With technologies, platforms and partnerships for a common goal: better health for
more people.

## Who We Are

Your life sciences journey deserves a partner that scales with you. ATS Life Sciences Group connects
discovery, process, and production into one seamless workflow—from early R&D to full commercial
manufacturing. Our integrated ecosystem combines proven life sciences technologies and
future-focused automation to ensure quality, consistency, and cost savings at every step.

**We earn our customers’ trust through consistency and dependability. **

[Learn More][21]

SEGMENTS

### Manufacturing Solutions

## Why Life Sciences Group

#### Expertise

Our proven insights ensure that no matter where you are in your journey, we can support your needs.

#### Innovation

We foster innovation by turning bold ideas into practical solutions that position our customers for
success.

#### Integration

We integrate systems seamlessly, delivering the power of unified skill and collaboration.

#### Reliability

We earn trust through consistency, accuracy, and compliance when it matters most

#### Quality

Our solutions consistently exceed expectations, ensuring lasting value and performance.

#### Service

From proactive maintenance to hands-on training, we deliver responsive service that maximizes asset
performance.

## Our Businesses

Life Sciences Group is a collection of six specialized  businesses  each contributing unique
expertise. Together, we provide a global ecosystem of solutions, serving customers across more than
20 countries with over 40 facilities and 3,750 employees.

# [125712-01 vs 149986-02 Differences for Bently Nevada 3500/32 4-Channel Relay Module][5]

[**Bently Nevada 3500/32**][6] 4-Channel Relay Module stands as a critical component in asset
condition monitoring systems, translating critical alarm signals into actionable responses to
protect your most valuable equipment.





A 3500 relay module is a multi-channel module composed of a main card known as the relay controller
and a relay output module. The relay controller interfaces with the 3500 system alarming network to
process its configured relay drive logic and generate relay channel drive signals. The relay I/O
module accepts the relay drive signals from the controller and contains the relay devices which
provide the machinery trip contacts.





3500/32 main card ordering number is **125712-01**,the upgrade 3500/32M ordering number is
149986-02. What’s the difference? Is the new code 149986-02 can replace of 125712-01?



125712-01 is built to match its exact OEM specs—epoxy-sealed construction, 250 Vrms arc suppressor,
and relay contacts rated for 100,000 cycles at 5 A, 24 Vdc/120 Vac. It’s a drop-in fit for the 3500
rack’s full-height front slot, requiring no reconfiguration for legacy setups. 149986-02 is the
dedicated spare for the upgraded 3500/32M, designed to support its enhanced features, including SIL
2 functional safety and ATEX/IECEx hazardous area certifications, plus expanded input compatibility
for Not-OK and PPL signals alongside standard alarm inputs.



Software and firmware compatibility further set them apart. 125712-01 works with older 3500 Rack
Configuration Software versions, needing no minimum rev levels for seamless integration—ideal for
facilities that haven’t upgraded their system software. 149986-02 has strict prerequisites: it
requires the 3500/22 TDI module (Rev 1.71+ firmware), 3500 Rack Configuration Software (Rev 4.5+),
and compatible display module firmware, ensuring the 3500/32M’s advanced logic and safety features
function as intended.





Their use cases diverge too: 125712-01 suits standard non-hazardous industrial environments where
the original 3500/32’s core alarm logic is sufficient, a cost-effective direct replacement for basic
setups. [**149986-02**][7] is built for high-stakes applications—hazardous areas, marine systems
(DNV GL/ABS certified), and functional safety setups—where the 3500/32M’s regulatory compliance and
upgraded performance are mandatory.

# [125712-01 vs 149986-02 Differences for Bently Nevada 3500/32 4-Channel Relay Module][5]

[**Bently Nevada 3500/32**][6] 4-Channel Relay Module stands as a critical component in asset
condition monitoring systems, translating critical alarm signals into actionable responses to
protect your most valuable equipment.





A 3500 relay module is a multi-channel module composed of a main card known as the relay controller
and a relay output module. The relay controller interfaces with the 3500 system alarming network to
process its configured relay drive logic and generate relay channel drive signals. The relay I/O
module accepts the relay drive signals from the controller and contains the relay devices which
provide the machinery trip contacts.





3500/32 main card ordering number is **125712-01**,the upgrade 3500/32M ordering number is
149986-02. What’s the difference? Is the new code 149986-02 can replace of 125712-01?



125712-01 is built to match its exact OEM specs—epoxy-sealed construction, 250 Vrms arc suppressor,
and relay contacts rated for 100,000 cycles at 5 A, 24 Vdc/120 Vac. It’s a drop-in fit for the 3500
rack’s full-height front slot, requiring no reconfiguration for legacy setups. 149986-02 is the
dedicated spare for the upgraded 3500/32M, designed to support its enhanced features, including SIL
2 functional safety and ATEX/IECEx hazardous area certifications, plus expanded input compatibility
for Not-OK and PPL signals alongside standard alarm inputs.



Software and firmware compatibility further set them apart. 125712-01 works with older 3500 Rack
Configuration Software versions, needing no minimum rev levels for seamless integration—ideal for
facilities that haven’t upgraded their system software. 149986-02 has strict prerequisites: it
requires the 3500/22 TDI module (Rev 1.71+ firmware), 3500 Rack Configuration Software (Rev 4.5+),
and compatible display module firmware, ensuring the 3500/32M’s advanced logic and safety features
function as intended.





Their use cases diverge too: 125712-01 suits standard non-hazardous industrial environments where
the original 3500/32’s core alarm logic is sufficient, a cost-effective direct replacement for basic
setups. [**149986-02**][7] is built for high-stakes applications—hazardous areas, marine systems
(DNV GL/ABS certified), and functional safety setups—where the 3500/32M’s regulatory compliance and
upgraded performance are mandatory.

Notably, 125712-01 and 149986-02 are genuine Bently Nevada parts but fully
non-interchangeable. Installing 149986-02 in a legacy 3500/32 causes functionality issues, while
125712-01 in a 3500/32M compromises safety certifications. The choice boils down to your system
version: 125712-01 for classic 3500/32, 149986-02 for advanced 3500/32M. Stocking the matched spare
ensures peak system performance, avoids costly mistakes, and keeps your 3500/32 asset monitoring
system protecting critical machinery reliably.

# Advanced Sensor Solutions
# Sales, Design and Manufacture


AV Sensors is an engineering company focused on the design, manufacture and sales of silicon
pressure sensors, transmitters, and transducers for the medical, industrial and consumer market. 
Our focus is to deliver high quality derivative based custom pressure sensors with minimal
development cost.  We can replicate most any MEMS pressure sensor with quick delivery.  We pride
ourselves having excellent service and have US based technical professionals that are the single
point of contact for all your needs.  AV Sensors is the antithesis of multinational companies that
now dominate the sensor space.

[Have a Question?][39]
[Need a Custom Product?][40]

# hours. 

[Have a Prouct that is Obsoleted][41]
[ or Discontinued?][42]

# AV Sensors have many products that replace discontinued pressure sensors from Amphenol, Nova
# Sensor, TE Connectivity, Measurement Specialties, Silicon Microstructures and Honeywell.

[Cross Now][43]
[Design Services][44]

AV Sensors restores low cost solutions with the confidence and ability to produce any pressure
sensor design on plastic, FR4, and ceramic substrates. 
 
Tell us about your need for a sensor solution.  We guarantee a response within 24 hrs.

## Explore by Sensor Type

[Board Mount][45]

AV Sensors has a large selection of board mount sensor products. Whether digital output, high level
analog, mV output compensated, or low cost uncompensated sensors; AV Sensors have the solution for
any product application or market. 

[[Board Mount Sensor]][46]
[High Accuracy][47]

AV Sensors offers glass bonded gage, epoxy bonded, and oil isolated technologies for industrial
transmitter products.  Married with the next generation of Mixed Signal ASICS these sensors support,
24 bit digital, ratiometric analog output, and traditional 4-20mA outputs.  

[[Oil Filled Sensor, Ribbon Cable]][48]
[Oil Isolated Industrial][49]
[Rugged Industrial][50]

AV Sensors  glass bonded gage industrial transducers  are are designed to measure pressure, flow and
temperature of corrosive and ionic gases used in compressors, refrigeration or process control
instrumentation.  With a one piece port construction and silicon gages bonded to a machined
diaphragm these sensors offer the highest protection again corrosive environments.  

[[MIMCT-7A Pressure Sensor]][51]
[Disposable Medical Sensors][52]

AV Sensors  Disposable  Medical Pressure Transducer contain a piezo resistive sensor element that
delivers a high level  mV output in a low cost, small footprint, leadless castellation package  that
can be used in single use medical applications. The sensors is designed and calibrated per the
Association for the Advancement of Medical Instrumentation (AAMI BP-22 Standard) guidelines. 

[[AAMI Specification]][53]
[Air Flow Sensors][54]

AV Sensors   has designed these Mass Air Flow Sensors from the ground up, incorporating the latest
MEMS and microelectronics innovations. The sensor die uses a pair of thermopiles to detect changes
in temperature caused by mass flow, delivering ultra-low noise and unsurpassed repeatability.

[[AWM 7 Mass Air Flow Sensor]][55]
[Cross Reference][56]

AV Sensors have many  sensors that are pin for pin compatible to those offered by Amphenol, Nova
Sensor, TE Connectivity, Measurement Specialties, Silicon Microstructures and Honeywell.  If you are
looking for improved pricing, delivery, or access to development engineers, this is you starting
point.

instrumentation.  With a one piece port construction and silicon gages bonded to a machined
diaphragm these sensors offer the highest protection again corrosive environments.  

[[MIMCT-7A Pressure Sensor]][51]
[Disposable Medical Sensors][52]

AV Sensors  Disposable  Medical Pressure Transducer contain a piezo resistive sensor element that
delivers a high level  mV output in a low cost, small footprint, leadless castellation package  that
can be used in single use medical applications. The sensors is designed and calibrated per the
Association for the Advancement of Medical Instrumentation (AAMI BP-22 Standard) guidelines. 

[[AAMI Specification]][53]
[Air Flow Sensors][54]

AV Sensors   has designed these Mass Air Flow Sensors from the ground up, incorporating the latest
MEMS and microelectronics innovations. The sensor die uses a pair of thermopiles to detect changes
in temperature caused by mass flow, delivering ultra-low noise and unsurpassed repeatability.

[[AWM 7 Mass Air Flow Sensor]][55]
[Cross Reference][56]

AV Sensors have many  sensors that are pin for pin compatible to those offered by Amphenol, Nova
Sensor, TE Connectivity, Measurement Specialties, Silicon Microstructures and Honeywell.  If you are
looking for improved pricing, delivery, or access to development engineers, this is you starting
point.  

[[Cross Reference, Products]][57]

[Instrumentation][60]

and surgical instrumentation.  Their design construction use the highest resolution ASICs, the
fastest conversion times along with safety critical diagnostic features that put them at the fore
front of new designs.   With legacy mV and high level voltage outputs as well as the newest 24 bit
and 16 bit digital output configurations an ideal solution is easily found. 


Our extensive expertise in sensing and sensors gives you direct access to the latest technology for

ideal solution is easily found. 
Our extensive expertise in sensing and sensors gives you direct access to the latest technology for

at the forefront of its development. With high-quality and reliable lab automation technology,
scientists are relieved from the labor-intensive, time-consuming tasks, allowing them to focus on
the science and achieve greater productivity than ever before.

foundation for artificial intelligence and machine learning applications. This structured data
enables smarter insights, predictive modeling, and data-driven decision-making across research and
development.

Lab automation is for labs of all sizes, done at all scales. BICO builds and offers solutions at all
scales, from standalone automation and workflow automation to end-to-end lab automation.

## Who We Serve

## Consumables Companies

For manufacturers of lab and bio-processing consumables and reagents, we enable cross-border
distribution, brand positioning, strategic partnering and OEM alliances.   

Whether you specialize in research (RUO) or in-vitro diagnostics (IVD) consumables and reagents our
team helps you with right Go To Market Strategy, partnering, regulatory readiness, and reach new
customers faster.

## Instrumentation Companies

We partner with manufacturers of research, diagnostic and pharma manufacturing instruments — from
lab essentials, analytical and automation systems.

BioBridge Lifescience helps instrumentation innovators expand their global reach, align with
strategic partners, and enter high-growth markets across North America, Asia, and the Middle East.

## Lifescience Software Companies

We help digital innovators in the field of AI, Bioinformatics, and Clinical Data Management software
— helping them connect with research, diagnostics and healthcare institutions networks worldwide.  

By aligning your technology with regional compliance, user needs, and sales channels, we accelerate
your market entry and adoption in the world’s fastest-growing life sciences ecosystem.

# Supporting scientists for the sake of science

## We exist to do whatever it takes to empower scientists to do their best work

Calibre Scientific Group is a diversified, global life sciences company with the goal of empowering
scientists by providing the high-quality products, services, and support they need.

[Learn more about us][39]
80,000+

market-leading products & services

18,000+

healthcare, diagnostics & life sciences customers

175

countries served

## Empowering Science®

The potential of science to improve every aspect of life grows stronger with each experiment, each
discovery, each breakthrough. The effects of scientific success are far-reaching, and the scientists
committed to driving that success are nothing short of incredible.

By equipping scientists with solutions to help remove unnecessary obstacles—made by people with a
firsthand understanding of what they are—we’re **empowering science. **And that benefits us all.

## Our businesses

Calibre Scientific Group's integrated platform includes three businesses that make up a
discovery-to-delivery solution serving a diversified customer base of pharmaceutical and industrial
companies, universities, hospitals, and reference labs.

[Explore Businesses][40]
[[Calibre Lab]][41]
Distribution Business

Distribution platform providing specialized products, robust sourcing capabilities, and responsive
support from experts.

[[Calibre Scientific]][42]
Proprietary Products Business

Leader in providing high-quality custom and off-the-shelf solutions, supported by technical experts,
for life sciences customers doing specialized applications.

[[Calibre Tec Service Division]][43]
Service Business

Dependable services across the full product lifecycle, including calibration and validation;
technical support and consulting; equipment installation and maintenance; and testing, inspection,
and measurement.

You are seeing this because the administrator of this website has set up Anubis to protect the
server against the scourge of AI companies aggressively scraping websites. This can and does cause
downtime for the websites, which makes their resources inaccessible for everyone.

Anubis is a compromise. Anubis uses a Proof-of-Work scheme in the vein of Hashcash, a proposed
proof-of-work scheme for reducing email spam. The idea is that at individual scales the additional
load is ignorable, but at mass scraper levels it adds up and makes scraping much more expensive.

Ultimately, this is a placeholder solution so that more time can be spent on fingerprinting and
identifying headless browsers (EG: via how they do font rendering) so that the challenge proof of
work page doesn't need to be presented to users that are much more likely to be legitimate.

Please note that Anubis requires the use of modern JavaScript features that plugins like JShelter
will disable. Please disable JShelter or other such plugins for this domain.

Sadly, you must enable JavaScript to get past this challenge. This is required because AI companies
have changed the social contract around how website hosting works. A no-JS solution is a
work-in-progress.

## Plantwide Automation

End-to-end plantwide automation services including process control, PLC and HMI programming, and
system upgrades. From front-end engineering, control system design, and specification through
implementation and project execution, we deliver integrated systems that streamline operations,
improve consistency, and provide real-time data visibility across the plant.

## Our Services & Solutions

[Industrial Server Rack OT Systems]

## [Industrial-IT-OT--Icon_Blue_Vector2 1]

## OT Systems

OT systems services including network architecture, assessments, server infrastructure design and
build, managed services, and firewall and DMZ implementation. We design and implement secure,
reliable environments that protect operations and enable consistent data exchange across the plant
and enterprise.

[Get Started][50]

## Our Services & Solutions

[Smart Factory with Data Overlay]

## [Manufacturing-Intelligence-Icon_Blue_Vector 2]

## Digital Manufacturing

Digital manufacturing services including application development, data collection and analysis,
historian systems, reporting solutions, and custom dashboards. We design and implement platforms
that deliver real-time data visibility, support enterprise reporting, and provide standardized
dashboards across sites.

[Get Started][51]

## Our Services & Solutions

[Screen displaying data and analytics in a factory]

MES services that enable accurate, real-time data capture and control of manufacturing operations.
We design and implement systems that improve schedule adherence, reduce downtime, and increase
throughput while connecting plant-floor activities with enterprise systems.

* ## **IMgenius**
  
  #### Accelerating the next generation of biologic drugs
  
  [Section image]
  
  ### Versatile
  
  #### Applies to a wide range of biologics
  
  Soft ionization conditions allow native conformations of biomacromolecules to be studied, e.g.,
  non-covalent protein complexes, high molecular weight aggregates, mRNA, glycoproteins, CRISPR-Cas,
  virus particles, lipid nanoparticles
  
  [Section image]
  
  ### Benchtop
  
  #### Fits easily into your lab
  
  IonDX’s patented ion mobility technology provides powerful analytical characterization in a very
  compact benchtop design.
  
  [Section image]
  
  ### Ion Mobility
  
  #### Operates at atmospheric pressure
  
  IMgenius determines the mobility of a population of molecular ions as they travel through a gas
  under the influence of an electric field. Small ions have higher mobility than larger ions because
  they experience less drag as they travel through a gas.
* ## Enabling a New Level of Ion Mobility Intelligence
  
  ### **MISSION**
  
  **IonDX™ Inc., based in Monterey, CA is commercializing an advanced system to analyze biologic
  drugs. The current biotherapeutic development cost is extremely high, >$2.5B and 8-10 years to
  introduce one of these drugs into the market. Our technology aims to improve analytical quality
  and reduce this cost by implementing a highly informative, fast, and reproducible assay. Our
  patented ion mobility spectrometers can simultaneously measure five important attributes of
  protein-based drugs: drug concentration, purity, stability and structural conformation of these
  molecules. We produce quantitative and correlative measurement in <5 minutes with our bench-top
  instrument. The short time range is rapid enough to introduce it in bioprocess environment where
  other technologies are too slow and unreliable. IonDX’s technology, being amenable to other
  analytical interfaces and automation, can fit into typical biotherapeutic high-throughput
  workflows, providing unique capability to reduce time and effort to bring a biotherapeutic to
  market.**
  
  ### **NSF SBIR AWARDS**
  
  **2019**
  
  **[NSF’s SBIR Phase II][27] awarded to IonDX on Sept 10, 2019 in support of ongoing development of
  our ion mobility spectrometer for macromolecular analysis.**
  
   
  
  **2017**
  
  **[NSF SBIR Phase ][28]I awarded to IonDX for our next-generation stand-alone electrospray ion
  mobility spectrometer.**

* ## **IMgenius**
  
  #### Accelerating the next generation of biologic drugs
  
  [Section image]
  
  ### Versatile
  
  #### Applies to a wide range of biologics
  
  Soft ionization conditions allow native conformations of biomacromolecules to be studied, e.g.,
  non-covalent protein complexes, high molecular weight aggregates, mRNA, glycoproteins, CRISPR-Cas,
  virus particles, lipid nanoparticles
  
  [Section image]
  
  ### Benchtop
  
  #### Fits easily into your lab
  
  IonDX’s patented ion mobility technology provides powerful analytical characterization in a very
  compact benchtop design.
  
  [Section image]
  
  ### Ion Mobility
  
  #### Operates at atmospheric pressure
  
  IMgenius determines the mobility of a population of molecular ions as they travel through a gas
  under the influence of an electric field. Small ions have higher mobility than larger ions because
  they experience less drag as they travel through a gas.
* ## Enabling a New Level of Ion Mobility Intelligence
  
  ### **MISSION**
  
  **IonDX™ Inc., based in Monterey, CA is commercializing an advanced system to analyze biologic
  drugs. The current biotherapeutic development cost is extremely high, >$2.5B and 8-10 years to
  introduce one of these drugs into the market. Our technology aims to improve analytical quality
  and reduce this cost by implementing a highly informative, fast, and reproducible assay. Our
  patented ion mobility spectrometers can simultaneously measure five important attributes of
  protein-based drugs: drug concentration, purity, stability and structural conformation of these
  molecules. We produce quantitative and correlative measurement in <5 minutes with our bench-top
  instrument. The short time range is rapid enough to introduce it in bioprocess environment where
  other technologies are too slow and unreliable. IonDX’s technology, being amenable to other
  analytical interfaces and automation, can fit into typical biotherapeutic high-throughput
  workflows, providing unique capability to reduce time and effort to bring a biotherapeutic to
  market.**
  
  ### **NSF SBIR AWARDS**
  
  **2019**
  
  **[NSF’s SBIR Phase II][27] awarded to IonDX on Sept 10, 2019 in support of ongoing development of
  our ion mobility spectrometer for macromolecular analysis.**
  
   
  
  **2017**
  
  **[NSF SBIR Phase ][28]I awarded to IonDX for our next-generation stand-alone electrospray ion
  mobility spectrometer.**

discovery. By developing the instruments and reagents you rely on each day, we strive to support

Your Partner in Discovery

science discovery. Committed to innovation, quality, and service, we offer an extensive product
portfolio featuring cutting-edge instruments and reagents for genome sequencing, microarray
analysis, nucleic acid purification, real-time PCR, and cell analysis.

online technical and application information, convenient on-site product supply programs, and expert
technical and customer service. Through our Industrial Business, we offer specialty biochemicals for
a wide range of industrial applications, as well as custom manufacturing. Explore our comprehensive

We celebrate the students, the researchers, the managers who work tirelessly in the pursuit of
discovery. By developing the instruments and reagents you rely on each day, we strive to support

## Life Sciences International, Inc. (LSI)** **is an international medtech, biotechnology and
## pharmaceutical expert services company serving all major markets of the world. We provide a
## comprehensive range of market access services from strategy development and analytics for
## reimbursement to clinical programs, health economics, and field advocacy for payer relations and
## clinical science liaison support. We are active in the U.S. across all types of payer
## environments, as well as Western Europe, Eastern Europe, Latin America, Canada, Japan, India,
## Turkey, South Korea, and China.

[
][29]

## WHAT WE DO

At the core of LSI’s value proposition is hands-on experience in managing and achieving results for
client products in the field, among all types of health care payers. We offer services in three
domains:

**Market Advocacy and Payer Relations**
**Market Strategy Development**
**Clinical Support and Health Economics**

[Learn more][30] [›][31] 

[
][32]

## OUR SOLUTIONS 

LSI offers a suite of solutions and services to fit your needs.  Medtech companies looking for
answers about technology and device reimbursement need a team of experts in reimbursement strategies
and payer relations.

[Learn more][33] [›][34]

[
][35]

## OUR COMPANIES 

LSI is designed to provide the structure needed to better support our customers. We provide not only
reimbursement, health economics and payer relations services, but also clinical effectiveness and
utility, clinical delivery integration, clinical trial optimization and medical and clinical science
liaison support to all clients.

[Learn more][36] [›][37]
 

[
[LSI_Brand_R04-25.png]
][38]

## OUR EXPERTISE 

LSI brings together areas of expertise that span virtually all medical disciplines.  Our experience
shows that though reimbursement fundamentals follow unique pathways, they apply to all medical and
surgical disciplines thereby making the reimbursement process as important to understand as the
medical discipline.  

[Learn more][39] [›][40]

[
[LSI_Brand_R04-27.png]
][41]

## OUR REACH 

LSI covers all major global markets, from the United States, to Europe, Latin America, Japan, India,
and China. Our in-country experts are specialized in market access, with both the technical
knowledge and relationship to achieve results.

[Learn more][42] [›][43]

 

[
][44]

## ABOUT US 

LSI works closely with clients to understand how the system works and to navigate the vagaries of
coding, coverage and payment.  Contact us to discuss how LSI can work with you to navigate the
complex reimbursement process in the US and internationally.  

[Learn more][45] [›][46]

[Contact us ›][47]

## Who We Are

Because our culture is focused on long-term relationships (with both our clients and our employees),
we are uniquely positioned to solve problems for manufacturers. We are independent and not owned by
an OEM, so we can offer innovative solutions without biases to simply and cost-effectively improve
plant operations. We’ve also built up a wide range of in-house capabilities that fill in the gaps
where other integrators stop short, adding more value and accountability to every project.

###### Our People

At LSI, our core values – service, integrity, and excellence – support our goal to provide the
highest level of benefit in what we do for our customers. Our employees are rewarded for providing
service to the customer first, acting with integrity, and showcasing technical excellence. LSI
employees value hard work and being part of something special.

###### Our Methods

We utilize project execution methodology and metrics tracking to ensure each job’s success. We
always strive for the right application of the proper technology for the purpose required. LSI is
large enough to execute multiple, multi-million dollar projects simultaneously, but small enough to
be responsive to our customers’ needs. We manage each project by focusing on quality, cost, and
schedule. A gap or compromise in any of these three areas will result in projects failing to meet
expectations.

###### Our Reputation

Reputation in the engineering services business is critical to long-term success. LSI knows that we
must excel on every project we do to earn the privilege of being invited back to provide more
services in the future. We depend on repeat business and realize that “we are only as good as our
last project.” We are proud of the fact that our very first customer from 1985 is still an active
and growing customer today.

## AUTOMATION, INSTRUMENTATION, CONTROL PANELS & VALIDATION SOLUTIONS FOR CRITICAL INDUSTRIES

For over 30 years, PACIV has helped biopharmaceutical, medical device, and water & wastewater
industries design, build, automate, and validate the systems that keep critical operations safe,
compliant, and running.

[ [message-sharp-thin-full (1)] CONTACT US ][37]
[b5250d2d]

# What We Do

From field devices to fully compliant systems, PACIV delivers integrated solutions across the entire
project life cycle.

[[Home Page - Process Automation-1]][38]

PLC, SCADA, and DCS system design and integration for reliable process control and monitoring.

[[Home Page - Control Panel Shop Services-1]][39]

Custom UL508A & UL698A certified control panels are engineered, built, and tested for industrial
applications. 

[[Home Page - Instrumentation Services-1]][40]

Installation, calibration, and maintenance of field instruments that measure and control critical
processes. 

[[Home Page - Validation Services-1]][41]
Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) and Computer System Validation (CSV) for FDA, GxP, and
regulatory compliance standards. 

# Industries We Serve

# Why PACIV
* **End-to-End Delivery**
  * From instrumentation to validation, one partner, complete solution.
* **In-House Control Panel Shop**
  * Faster turnaround and higher quality control.
* **Regulatory Expertise**
  * Deep expertise with FDA, GxP, and data integrity.
* **Cross Industry Experience**
  * Proven across life sciences and critical infrastructures.

## AUTOMATION, INSTRUMENTATION, CONTROL PANELS & VALIDATION SOLUTIONS FOR CRITICAL INDUSTRIES

For over 30 years, PACIV has helped biopharmaceutical, medical device, and water & wastewater
industries design, build, automate, and validate the systems that keep critical operations safe,
compliant, and running.

[ [message-sharp-thin-full (1)] CONTACT US ][37]
[b5250d2d]

# What We Do

From field devices to fully compliant systems, PACIV delivers integrated solutions across the entire
project life cycle.

[[Home Page - Process Automation-1]][38]

PLC, SCADA, and DCS system design and integration for reliable process control and monitoring.

[[Home Page - Control Panel Shop Services-1]][39]

Custom UL508A & UL698A certified control panels are engineered, built, and tested for industrial
applications. 

[[Home Page - Instrumentation Services-1]][40]

Installation, calibration, and maintenance of field instruments that measure and control critical
processes. 

[[Home Page - Validation Services-1]][41]
Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) and Computer System Validation (CSV) for FDA, GxP, and
regulatory compliance standards.

## Your Partners in Life Science

### Together we are stronger

PiLS is a non-profit knowledge network created by experts, each with more than a decade of
experience in successful life sciences innovation. Our network is here to offer you advice and
guidance across the entire value chain from idea to product. Our connected companies are then ready
to make your project happen.

By sharing knowledge with each other we streamline your journey, create more value, and get you
where you need to go, faster.

## Who we are

### A comprehensive network of experts and expertise

The PiLS members have broad expertise in a variety of areas that span the life cycle of your
project. Their knowledge and experience is at your disposal.

### A network with a network

By connecting with PiLS you gain access not only to a network of experts, but also to the extended
network of our members within their respective companies and outside. Hospitals, researchers,
investors – all within arm’s reach.

### A network that helps to turn ideas into success

The PiLS experts can give you the information you need to move forward with your project, but they
can also help you to put that information into action.

### Trusted Expertise, Full Support

Quantum Composers offers industry-leading digital delay generators, synchronization systems, and
custom timing solutions for a wide range of applications.  For 30 years, we have been
offering [pulse generators][62], and custom electro-optics instruments. 

Scientists, researchers, and OEMs use our high-performance digital delay generators designed for
precise timing, synchronization, and control across demanding applications and industries.
* Research and Universities
* Aerospace and defense
* Medical, dental, and life sciences
* Spectroscopy
* Material science

Features like:
* Up to 5ps timing resolution
* Multi-channel synchronization

# RETSCH - Milling & Sieving

Retsch is the leading manufacturer of laboratory mills, jaw crushers and sieving equipment. With
more than 100 years of experience, Retsch develops innovative solutions for neutral-to-analysis
sample preparation and particle size analysis. Trusted by researchers and quality control
laboratories around the world, Retsch products are defined by excellent performance, ease of use,
safety and a long lifetime. As the market and technology leader, we are offering the most
comprehensive range of equipment.

### **Safe. Gentle. Precise. **

The new Safety-Multifly^{®} PRO combines maximum user safety with a high level of patient comfort.
The semi-automatic safety mechanism activates the needle in the vein, reducing the risk of needle
stick injuries and blood splatter after blood collection, while the ultra-thin-walled needle
supports a high level of patient comfort thanks to reduced insertion force and gentle blood flow.

of pre-analysis, life science, laboratory automation and sample transport. The needs of the user are
always at the centre of our solutions.

[ICN Life-Science 1024x1024]

### Life Science

In the areas of liquid handling, cell culture, molecular biology, sample handling and microbiology,

innovation and product development across various fields, including biotechnology, ATMPs,
pharmaceutical engineering, radiopharmaceuticals, food safety, water quality, and advanced
materials.

supporting consumables, and services for life science research and industrial applications.
